b_artoria5: Artoria : Merlin exists in your world!?
b_sora7: Sora : Yeah. We met him back in Traverse Town. He told us King Mickey asked him to help us out on our journey. Since then, he’s been helping us whenever we were on a journey.

b_p6: Artoria nodded, her surprise still shown on her face.
b_artoria6: Artoria : Yes, I know him. Merlin was the one who taught me how to become a king. In fact, the little creature on your shoulder happens to be his familiar.
b_sora9b: Sora asked, looking at the creature in question but flinched in surprise when he saw the angry look on his face.
b_p7: Sora sweat dropped at Fou, wondering why Fou was so mad but then blinked and snapped his fingers in realization catching their attention.
b_sora10: Sora : Oh yeah! Now I remember! Merlin told us that before he was a world traveler, he came from a world where he met someone, a 12 year boy named Arthur and gave him an education. Something about teaching him ’brains over brawn’. He got a little mad at Arthur for not following his teachings and left but when he came back he found out Arthur became king after pulling a sword from the stone and was happy for him.
b_p8: Artoria blinked a couple of times at Sora, her dumbfounded expression showing on her face which was shared by them, that didn’t sound like the Merlin they knew. The Merlin they knew wasn’t someone who teaches ’brains over brawn’ to someone else. He was a pervert, a con man, and lacked any sense of responsibility. Plus he was someone who often visited others in their dreams like she was forced to experience.
b_p9: But wait…a 12 year old boy as a king? She was 15 when she pulled Excalibur out and stopped aging because of it. And that thing about being a world traveler…that too should be impossible because Merlin is currently trapped at the Garden of Avalon as they speak!
b_p10: Archer looked to Sora then back to Artoria, blinking all the while. Something wasn’t right. Arthur being a 12 year old boy who pulled Excalibur out was one thing? But Merlin? He never met Merlin personally but he knows much about him after learning about him from the Saber Artoria in his timeline. There was no legend saying that Merlin is a ’world traveler’ as Sora said, for he was currently stuck in a tower called the Garden of Avalon. So there was no way the Merlin Sora is talking about was the same one as in this…
b_archer3: Archer : Oh, you gotta be kidding me.
b_sora11: Sora : But wait a sec, Merlin also said he has a talking pet owl named Archimedes. It shouldn’t be Fou.
b_sora11b: Sora said, looking at Fou with confusion who also looked back at him feeling the same.
b_archer4b: Archer spoke up, getting everyone’s attention.
b_archer5: Archer : Before anybody says anything else, Sora, do you have a picture of Merlin on your phone?
b_sora12: Sora : Yeah, hold on for a sec.
b_p11a: Taking out his phone and scrolling through the pictures, Sora stopped at a pic that he took of Merlin back in
b_p12: Artoria and Archer leaned over Sora’s shoulder to look at the picture with Fou looking at it too. Artoria’s mouth opened up in surprise with her eyes widened as well with Fou doing the same thing while Archer blinked, his brows shooting upwards.
b_p13: The picture showed an elderly man with pale skin and thin arms and legs. His nose is a bit large and his black eyes are rather small and close-set. He wears spectacles with circular lenses. He seems to be balding and has short, white hair on the sides and back of his head. He also has bushy eyebrows, a walrus mustache, and a long, floor-length beard, all of which are white. He was dressed in an outfit that was typical for a wizard to wear, which is a sky blue cloak that stops just above his ankles and has large, hanging sleeves. He wears pointed slippers and a tall, floppy, conical hat, both of which are the same sky blue color as his cloak. The wand he was holding is a very long, featureless, brown rod with a small bump on one end. He also had a cup of tea in his hands.
b_p14: All in all to Artoria and Fou, this elderly man looked like a kind and caring grandfather with so much wisdom to share and not the one they were expecting.
b_artoria8b: Artoria asked, her tone was disbelief.
b_sora14: Sora : What do you mean? It’s Merlin!
b_sora14b: Sora answered, now looking between her and Fou.
b_sora15: Sora : You said you know him, right?
b_artoria9b: Artoria said, not taking her eyes off the…old man Merlin.
b_artoria10: Artoria : But the man in the picture is not the Merlin Fou and I know!
b_fou3b: Fou seemed to agree as he nodded his head at Sora, who now looked surprised. He ran on Sora’s arm to the phone and tapped its paw on Merlin’s face.
b_archer6b: Archer said, once again getting the other’s attention.
b_archer7: Archer : First The Little Mermaid, then Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, and now this. You have a different version of Merlin in your world.
b_sora16: Sora : A...different Merlin? Wait, you mean there’s another Merlin in this world!?
b_sora16b: Sora asked, now feeling shocked that another Merlin exists somewhere in this world.
b_artoria11b: Artoria said, now frowning as she thought about…this world’s Merlin.
b_artoria12: Artoria : The Merlin we know is a whole lot younger, whom he calls himself a ’big brother’ so to speak. He’s also not a world traveler as your Merlin is.
b_p15: She paused and looked at Sora.
b_artoria13: Artoria : Does his magic revolve around flowers and is he half incubus?

b_fou5b: Fou nodded his head at the confused Sora.
b_sora19: Sora : O…kay? Still, another version of Merlin exists in this world.

b_sora20: Sora : Man, that’s cool! I hope I get to meet him! What’s he like?
b_p23: Artoria and Fou stared at Sora blankly, earning a blink in response from him, before glancing to another, then back to the image of Sora’s Merlin. Artoria frowned slightly, huffed and walked away back to camp, her eyes closed.
b_artoria14: Artoria : My Merlin should take lessons from yours.

b_sora21: Sora : What kind of person is this world’s Merlin?

c_p2: A joyous yet sheepish laugh could be heard from inside the tower where a young man is seen sitting down on the floor, leaning his back against the pillar.

c_merlin2: ??? : And that grandpa version of me sounds like he’s living the good old retired happy life being a world traveler! I bet it’s because Vivian doesn’t even exist in that world, oh how lucky he is!
c_p3: He stood up and walked towards the balcony, where he looked at the vast land filled with flowers.
c_merlin3: ??? : The other side of reality, where anything that’s fictional here, is real over there. I believe we should call it…a fictional world.
c_merlin3b: The young man mused to himself.
c_merlin4: ??? : A world where the forces of light and darkness clash in order to protect or obtain the great power known as Kingdom Hearts. How fascinating.

c_p6: Even though he doesn’t know him, it feels like he does. Just seeing him and hearing his name…it made him feel very happy. Yet he didn’t know why. Is it because of his connection to the other Merlin, perhaps? Either way, it doesn’t change anything.
c_merlin5b: The young man opened his eyes to look up at the sky, his eyes filled with hope.
c_merlin6: ??? : If it’s you…then maybe I can finally be free from this tower.
d_p1: After coming back from gathering ingredients and having dinner made thanks to Archer, everyone had already set up camp so that they could get some sleep after a long day. While they were eating dinner, Sora had told everyone what he learned about earlier. Of course the others were stunned to hear, none more so than Dr. Roman, who completely freaked out after hearing that there was a Merlin in Sora’s world and how different he was compared to the one in this world. Even adding to the fact that King Arthur is a 12 year old boy in that world.
d_p2a: It was a day filled with stories of Sora telling everyone about his Merlin and him taking pictures. He was also surprised to see that when he took pictures of the Servants, he saw their status and information appear on his phone, including their history and their skills, just like
d_p3: Later that night, Saber, Ritsuka, Mash and Fou went to sleep in the big tent that they set up. Archer and Lancer decided to enter spirit form, which shocked Sora to see them do something like that and also kinda creeped him out. The only one sitting by the fire was Jeanne as she was going over what she learned today.
d_p4: Chaldea. The incineration of humanity’s future and those two children were sent here to help fix the problem. This situation is far worse than she thought. None of this was supposed to happen. The Dragon Witch, her being summoned, all this was because of the Singularity that appeared in this era. And she was only focused on this other Jeanne and what she was doing to her homeland, when the world as a whole is far worse off.
d_p5a: But it wasn’t all that bad in the end as they were getting help from the Keyblade Master named Sora, who comes from a world on the other side of their universe. Ritsuka, Mash and even Lancer told her about Sora’s most dangerous adventures as he and his companions traveled between many worlds to protect them from creatures created from the darkness called Heartless and from the man named
d_p5b: , who seeked to use the greatest power in the whole universe called Kingdom Hearts to purge the worlds in order for darkness to not appear.
d_p6: She was, in a word, awestruck to hear such a tale and to hear that such a young boy actually started this journey at the age of 14. She had no idea that such a universe actually exists on the other side of their reality and what’s more that such a thing as the heart of all worlds would actually exist in that world.
d_p7: Sora…despite being slightly younger than her, he had experienced much more than she or anybody else in this world had. He saw many worlds, he fought against the forces of darkness, he saved those worlds from many of Xehanort’s incarnations. And because of his actions of using this Power of Waking, he was banished from his world for breaking a great taboo, never to return there again.
d_p8: Such a sad thing to happen to him. He only used that power to save his loved ones from death. Yet even then, no matter how noble the action was, the world would never forgive those who break a forbidden taboo. And as a result, he completely lost all of his power and was brought over here.
d_p9: That would explain why he felt different from the humans here and that strange feeling she felt earlier when they shook hands. That bright and warm feeling. It was Sora’s light that touched her heart. The feeling of hope. Hope that with Sora being here, things will change.
d_jeanne1: Jeanne : The darkness in people’s hearts…
d_jeanne1b: Jeanne said, placing her hand on her chest as she thought about the other Jeanne.
d_jeanne2: Jeanne : And from that darkness, the Heartless are born. Could it be…that the other ’me’, might be my darkness? The darkness that somehow escaped from me after my death? Is she my Heartless? Just who or what is she?
d_jeanne3: Jeanne : No, more importantly, am I the real Jeanne d’Arc?
d_p11: Of course you’re the real Jeanne.
d_p12: Jeanne jumped at the voice that spoke to her and turned around to see Sora walking up to her and taking a seat next to her.
d_sora1: Sora : I was gazing up at the stars for a little while, wondering what kind of worlds exist here. I was about to head back to sleep until I saw you were still up.
d_jeanne5b: Jeanne said, staring back at the fire.
d_jeanne6: Jeanne : Honestly? No. I…I’m panicking right now just thinking about the other ’me’.
d_jeanne7: Jeanne : And after learning about the darkness in our hearts, the Heartless, it’s making me wonder if the other me might be my darkness that somehow escaped, which explains why my power is the way it is now
d_p14: Sora stared at her for a second before looking at the flames.
d_sora3: Sora : I don’t think the other Jeanne is your darkness and I know for sure that you are the real Jeanne d’Arc.
d_p15: Jeanne immediately turned to look at him.
d_jeanne8: Jeanne : How could you possibly know that?
d_sora4b: Sora simply said, stunning her into silence.

d_sora8b: , where the Keyblade War happened, I helped Ven fight Vanitas off. After we beat him, his mask cracked and that’s when I saw his face.

d_jeanne10: Jeanne : But…wouldn’t that mean…you three are spiritually brothers in a way?
d_jeanne10b: Jeanne asked, too stunned to hear this tale. She had no idea the human heart was actually capable of doing such a thing.

Before he disappeared, Vanitas already made his decision to just be darkness and that he was okay with it.
d_jeanne11b: Jeanne said, placing her hand on her chest.
d_jeanne12: Jeanne : To choose to stay with darkness and not with your brothers in all but blood. How could anyone choose such a fate and be okay with it?
d_p20: Sora didn’t answer as he kept talking.
d_sora11: Sora : When Archer and Dr. Roman told me about your history, I was angry.
d_sora12: Sora : I was angry at how the people in this era would just brand you as a witch and even going so far as to torture you when you were captured before burning you alive. Even thinking about it still makes me really angry.
d_sora12b: He gripped his pant legs a little, unknowingly showing Jeanne this.
d_sora13: Sora : But when I read your history on my phone, I was amazed. You never once showed any kind of hatred or resentment to the people who were shouting or cursing at you. You just kept going without any kind of regret. It takes an incredibly strong heart to endure all that kind of hatred and you did it without responding back to it. I look up to you because of it.
d_p21: Jeanne was touched by hearing how Sora felt about her death and to hear those words he said about her with respect in his tone. He turned to look at her with a smile on his face.
d_sora14: Sora : That’s how I know she’s not your darkness Jeanne.
d_sora15: Sora : Despite everything that’s happened to you, that you’ve endured when you were captured, your heart is still full of light, because you loved your home and fought to protect it. You don’t have to worry about the other Jeanne being your darkness or if she’s the real one. As far as I can tell, you are the real Jeanne d’Arc. Your words and actions from earlier proved it! You’re a hero to the people of this world. So don’t ever doubt yourself like that again, okay?
d_jeanne13b: Jeanne said, stunned to hear him say that which also caused her to blush.

g_p1: Of course, Sora and Ritsuka were shocked to learn the basic history of the four new Servants before them from Mash.
g_p2: Marie is the actual Queen of France who tragically lost her life due to the events of the French Revolution. Sora actually stood in salute after finding that Marie is the queen, a habit he, Donald and Goofy shared whenever they meet new royalty, but Marie waved it off and told him to treat her normally which made him relax.
g_p3: Mozart is one of history’s greatest musician and was a close friend to Marie. Elizabeth, known as the ’Blood Countess’ was a serial killer and was the inspiration for the legend of the vampire. Kiyohime is from a legend in Ritsuka’s home country called Japan and according to Mash, she got angry at someone and turned into a dragon.
g_p4: Sora and Ritsuka gaped at Mash after hearing the last two and they both paled slightly as they gave each other uncertain and worried looks. Sora couldn’t believe that a serial killer of all things is in fact a Heroic Spirit and that Elizabeth is the reason why the vampire legend started in this world.
g_p5: She didn’t even look like a killer! She looked like she would fit right in at Halloween Town just like the other two Servants Dark Jeanne has. It’s true what they say, never judge a book by it’s color. But that doesn’t mean he shouldn’t get to know her. After all, she seemed like a pretty fun girl.
g_p6: As for Kiyohime, Sora was more surprised and excited than worried. In fact, he immediately ran up to her and started asking her a lot questions which surprised her greatly to see his child-like interest in her.
g_p7: But Roman appeared to put a stop to that as they had a lot of things to talk about.
g_p8: So after setting up camp in the layline area, the group sat and exchanged information with one another. Apparently, Marie and the others were summoned here by the Holy Grail itself to solve the anomalies that were in this Singularity. They proved it as they had no Masters which should be impossible as a Master is what ties the Servant to this world and the only thing that could do that was the Grail itself. It kinda sounded like Jeanne was in the same boat as them.
g_p9: Once that was done, the Chaldea group told them what was going on in their end. They then started a discussion about Dark Jeanne and her Servants who were all combat based while Mozart and Marie were more support types and weren’t suited for combat. So aside from the three combat Servants that are here with them, Mash didn’t have enough experience yet and Jeanne lost nearly all her powers, it was still four, counting Sora, against five Servants and a large dragon.
g_p10: Marie suggested that they look for more allies as that would even the playing field for them and make up the extra strength they need. But this also means that Dark Jeanne might be searching for those allies as well so it would be best that they search for them.
g_p11: Sora meanwhile was more focused on Dark Jeanne, thinking about the darkness that he felt from her. He knew that he felt her darkness but there was also another darkness that wasn’t hers mixed in with it. That was the proof he needed. He was certain now that Dark Jeanne wasn’t the dark side of Jeanne.
g_p12: But who was it? Who’s darkness was it that was mixed in with Dark Jeanne?
g_p13: He has to think back on what he learned.
g_p14: The Holy Grail War is a war to fight for the Holy Grail and get a wish granted. There’s a Grail War happening right now in this era with too many Servants appearing. Dark Jeanne appeared first to serve as a Ruler for this Grail War after Jeanne’s death, with her summoning the Heroic Spirits. The real Jeanne appearing only yesterday with her losing her powers as a Ruler. Then the Grail summoned Marie and the others to help solve the anomalies of this Grail War.
g_p15: But Dark Jeanne’s appearance after the real Jeanne’s death. It’s almost if someone had found the Holy Grail in this era first and used it to try and…
g_sora1: Sora : That’s it! I think I figured it out!
g_sora1b: Sora exclaimed, bringing all talking to a halt as everyone turned to him in confusion.
g_sora2: Sora : The truth about Dark Jeanne.
g_sora2b: Sora answered, now getting their undivided attention.
g_jeanne1: Jeanne : What do you mean, Sora?
g_sora3: Sora : Guys, remember back in Fuyuki where Artoria and the others, except for Cú, were corrupted by the Grail?
g_sora3b: Sora asked Ritsuka and Mash as he turned to them.
g_sora4: Sora : Well, when I first heard about Jeanne being the Dragon Witch back at the fort, I was thinking that the same thing might’ve happened to her.
g_sora5: Sora : But when Jeanne appeared and after learning about Dark Jeanne, I threw that idea away. When we met her, I felt nothing but darkness from her. But it wasn’t just her darkness I felt, there was another darkness as well!
g_p17: That made everyone look confused as they blinked at Sora.
g_sora6: Sora : Another darkness that belonged to someone else. I felt that person’s darkness and it was mixed in with Dark Jeanne.
g_sora6b: Sora continued his explanation but he still saw the lost looks everyone was giving him. Okay, he gotta try it a different way.
g_sora7: Sora : Er, right. Let’s think about it like this. The Holy Grail is said to grant a wish to whoever holds it, right?
g_sora8: Sora : Okay, now what if there was someone, who shouldn’t be here in this era, found the Holy Grail and learned that Jeanne died?
g_sora9: Sora : That someone used the Grail to try and bring Jeanne back to life but it wouldn’t work no matter how many times they tried, so they went with an alternative. What if that person instead decided to create another Jeanne d’Arc but in their image?
g_p19: Everyone’s eyes slowly widened, now understanding what Sora was implying, even those at Chaldea who were listening in. Jeanne herself looked speechless to hear this.
g_ritsuka2: Ritsuka : Sora…are you saying that someone used the Grail to create the Dragon Witch?
g_ritsuka2b: Ritsuka asked, slowly making sure he heard right.
g_sora10: Sora : Yeah! It’s like I said earlier, Jeanne and Dark Jeanne are different people. One’s not her darkness and the other isn’t the light that was ripped away. They may have the same face but they’re not the same person. And I think the one who created her might also be a Servant as well.

g_archer2: Archer : Which means that Dark Jeanne doesn’t just have the Holy Grail.
g_jeanne2b: Jeanne replied this time, looking downwards at the ground.
g_jeanne3: Jeanne : And the Servant who created her…must be someone I know.

g_jeanne4: Jeanne : I don’t even think she herself knows the truth about her origins or what she really is.
g_mash1: Mash : Meaning that this Servant is keeping Dark Jeanne in the dark about her origins.
g_mash1b: Mash said, now feeling sorry for Dark Jeanne.

g_artoria1b: Artoria said, placing her hands under her chin as she frowned in thought.

g_romani5: Romani : [We may even find out who this mysterious Servant that created Dark Jeanne is. But for now, we should be more focused on finding the allies.]
g_p21: He will never forgive Dark Jeanne for what she has done to this country and to what she said to Jeanne. All the people she murdered, the lives she ruined in her pursuit for revenge, how could he?
g_p22: But he also knows that those feelings she had weren’t really her own. They were the influence of the Servant who created her. This Servant must’ve felt deeply saddened to hear Jeanne’s death and birthed a deep burning hatred of France for killing her.
g_p23: They must’ve tried very hard to use the Grail to wish Jeanne back to life which only ended in failure. So they decided to create a new Jeanne by using the Grail’s power and their own dark feelings towards France to give birth to Dark Jeanne, who believed that she was the real Jeanne d’Arc when the truth is…she’s a fake.
g_p25: For all he knows, Dark Jeanne only has memories of her death and not the memories of Jeanne’s family because the Servant who created her doesn’t know them. It was their influence that created her.
g_p26: The Keyblade Master grew a look of determination and nodded his head. Once he see Dark Jeanne again, he’ll find out who it was that created her.
g_p27: And when he meet this mysterious Servant, he’ll be ready for them.
